en: The front of the postcard shows a black and white photograph featuring an expansive view over a harbor with docks, warehouses, ships, and buildings along the water, with forested hills and scattered houses in the background. The bottom of the image contains Swedish text that reads 'Sundsvall. Utsikt över hamnen.' The reverse side displays handwritten text in Swedish, a 10 öre Swedish postage stamp, and a postal cancellation mark.
